messages:
mira: Quick announcement: rolling out new Dedicated GPU SKUs and region updates today.

mira: Summary: H100 (80GB) now available as Dedicated SKU in ap-northeast-1 (limited warm pool). GH200 (128GB) live in us-east-1 and eu-central-1 for Reserved Dedicated.

dan: Any high-level perf/price guidance?

mira: Perf: GH200 shines for long-context >32k and high concurrency; H100 gives better per-token throughput for medium contexts. Pricing: GH200 reserved multiplier ~1.8x vs A100 baseline; H100 reserved ~1.6x; warm/burst units pricier per-burst.

ops-bot: [system] Inventory: GH200-us-east-1: 20 units, GH200-eu-central-1: 14 units, H100-ap-northeast-1 (warm): 8 units. Live dashboard: /dedicated/inventory.

rafa: How do teams test and migrate? auto-rollout?

mira: Recommend manual pinning + canary. Use Console blueprints or CLI snippet: `rw dedicated plan --region eu-central-1 --gpu GH200 --model ./models/long-context`.

sana: Any tenancy or quota restrictions for customers?

mira: Yes: initial GH200 allocations require reserved commit or approved quota increase. H100 warm pool is burst-only until inventory expands. Support flow links in the KB.

dan: Will Hosted API be affected?

mira: No automatic changes. We may introduce H100-backed hosted tiers later this quarter; current Hosted pools unchanged.

rafa: Ops: please enable small test clusters for teams.

ops-bot: [system] GH200/H100 test cluster provisioning enabled. Request via /ops request dedicated-test-gpu {team: <team-name>}.

sana: Thanks, will take the summarizer to GH200 canary next week.

mira: Follow-up thread with perf snapshots and KB links coming shortly.
